segments.text: My name is James Myrmekis and I am a civil rights slash constitutional attorney.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I have filed over 150 individual lawsuits on behalf of firemen and policemen and some teachers as well.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: In addition, I have a few class actions also pending against the city of New York.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I was successful in filing temporary restraining orders on behalf of all my clients and getting them stays of their termination until the article 78 proceeding was decided.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: And basically, I'm going to be discussing the procedure where you could appeal a panel decision.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: I mean, this Eric Adams, when he rescinded
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: The mandate on February 10th was in a live interview the same day and said that he will feel the need to reinstate him in the future.
segments.speaker: SPEAKER_00

segments.text: So I do think that this is something that will come up again and I think it's important for lawyers to learn this type of law, especially with all the COVID litigation that's happening now and that's going to happen in the future.
